title: The Samsung S26 Ultra is already marked down to $920 for Prime Day
summary: Amazon has the 256GB Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra on sale for $919.99 (usually $1,099.99) for Prime Day, a significant discount for a phone that released just a few months ago in March. The S26 Ultra has a set of four rear cameras for excellent photos, a refined design that’s comfortable to use, and a built-in privacy screen you can customize and toggle. Samsun…
contentText:
Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra

Where to Buy:

- $1299.99 $919.99 at Amazon (256GB)

- $1299.99 $934.99 at Best Buy (256GB)

- $1499.99 $1119.99 at Amazon (512GB)

On top of that, it has all of the upgraded components you’d want from a smartphone that’s almost $1,000, with 256GB of internal storage, 12GB of memory, and fast charging up to 60W with a compatible charger. The S26 Ultra notably lacks a Qi2 magnet, so you may want to pick up a case that includes one, but it does have a spot to stow the included S Pen stylus.
